WITH race_stats AS (
  SELECT r.name, 
         AVG(ds.points) as avg_points, 
         COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) as driver_count
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(driver_count) as avg_count FROM race_stats
),
filtered_races AS (
  SELECT rs.avg_points, rs.driver_count, oac.avg_count
  FROM race_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oac
  WHERE rs.driver_count > oac.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_points),
  AVG(driver_count),
  AVG(driver_count - avg_count)
FROM filtered_races
